response.overview: Sasuntsi Davit is a 2010 Armenian animated film based on the Armenian national epic Sasna Tsrer. The film tells the story of David of Sassoun, a legendary hero who rises to defend his homeland and its people against foreign rule.  The story follows David from his childhood in Sassoun to his emergence as a courageous and powerful warrior. He eventually confronts Msra Melik, a powerful ruler who seeks to conquer Sassoun and subjugate its people. David’s struggle against him forms the central conflict of the film.  The film combines Armenian folklore, mythology, and traditional storytelling with animation, presenting themes of courage, freedom, justice, loyalty, and devotion to one’s homeland. Through the story of David, the film portrays one of the most enduring heroes of Armenian cultural tradition.
response.title: Daredevils of Sassoun - Davit from Sassoun
